notes.title: Wonderful Everyday Update
notes.content:
An update for the game is now available.

- Fixed text related issues
- Fixed an issue related to some backgrounds
- Fixed a few minor visual issues in the Extras

For the users playing the patched version: [b][u]please do not forget to download the updated version of the patch and apply it again before starting the game.[/u][/b]
